JOIN "experiences" e ON e."applicant_id" = a."id"
ORDER BY CAST(e."years_of_experience" AS INTEGER) ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;
291:
SELECT
    l."locationname" AS location,
    j."base_pay_range",
    j."benefits"
FROM "jobs" j
JOIN "locations" l ON j."locationid" = l."id"
ORDER BY l."locationname" ASC NULLS FIRST, j."base_pay_range" ASC NULLS FIRST;
292:
SELECT l."locationname", j."benefits"
FROM "jobs" j
JOIN "locations" l ON j."locationid" = l."id"
ORDER BY l."locationname" ASC NULLS FIRST, j."benefits" ASC NULLS FIRST;
293:
SELECT jt."typename", j."base_pay_range"
FROM "jobs" j
JOIN "jobtypes" jt ON j."jobtypeid" = jt."id"
ORDER BY jt."typename" ASC NULLS FIRST, j."base_pay_range" DESC NULLS LAST;
294:
SELECT DISTINCT
    jt."typename",
    j."base_pay_range",
    j."benefits"
FROM "jobs" j
JOIN "jobtypes" jt ON j."jobtypeid" = jt."id"
ORDER BY jt."typename" ASC NULLS FIRST, j."base_pay_range" ASC NULLS FIRST;
295:
SELECT
    l."locationname" AS location,
    j."base_pay_range" AS base_pay_range
FROM "jobs" j
JOIN "locations" l ON j."locationid" = l."id"
ORDER BY l."locationname" ASC NULLS FIRST, j."base_pay_range" ASC NULLS FIRST;
296:
WITH total_projects AS (
    SELECT
        e."applicant_id" AS applicant_id,
        SUM(e."number_of_completed_projects") AS total_completed
    FROM "experiences" e
    GROUP BY e."applicant_id"
),

min_applicant AS (
    SELECT tp.applicant_id
    FROM total_projects tp
    ORDER BY tp.total_completed ASC NULLS FIRST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    a."name",
    a."phone"
FROM "applicants" a
JOIN min_applicant ma ON a."id" = ma.applicant_id;
297:
SELECT j."id", j."job_post", l."locationname"
FROM "jobs" j
JOIN "locations" l ON j."locationid" = l."id"
ORDER BY l."locationname" ASC NULLS FIRST, j."id" ASC NULLS FIRST;
306:
SELECT a."name", a."email"
FROM applicants a
JOIN experiences e ON a."id" = e."applicant_id"
ORDER BY e."years_of_experience"::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;
307:
SELECT a."name", a."email"
FROM "applicants" a
JOIN "experiences" e ON e."applicant_id" = a."id"
WHERE e."years_of_experience" = (
    SELECT MAX(e2."years_of_experience")
    FROM "experiences" e2
);
308:
SELECT jt."typename", j."base_pay_range"
FROM "jobs" j
JOIN "jobtypes" jt ON j."jobtypeid" = jt."id"
ORDER BY jt."typename" ASC NULLS FIRST, j."base_pay_range" ASC NULLS FIRST;
310:
SELECT
    h."name" AS hotel_name,
    AVG(r."number_of_stars"::numeric) AS rating
FROM "hotels" h
JOIN "reviews" r ON r."hotelid" = h."hotelid"
GROUP BY h."hotelid", h."name"
ORDER BY rating DESC NULLS LAST;
323:
SELECT h."name" AS hotel_name, r."customer_reviews", r."number_of_stars"
FROM reviews r
JOIN hotels h ON r."hotelid" = h."hotelid"
ORDER BY h."name" ASC NULLS FIRST, r."number_of_stars" DESC NULLS LAST;
324:
SELECT
    c."fullname" AS customer,
    r."number_of_stars" AS stars
FROM "reviews" r
JOIN "customers" c ON c."customerid" = r."customerid"
ORDER BY c."fullname" ASC NULLS FIRST, r."number_of_stars" DESC NULLS LAST;
325:
SELECT h."name", r."number_of_stars"
FROM "hotels" h
JOIN "reviews" r ON h."hotelid" = r."hotelid"
ORDER BY h."name" ASC NULLS FIRST, r."number_of_stars" DESC NULLS LAST;
326:
SELECT r."customer_reviews", r."number_of_stars", c."fullname"
FROM "reviews" r
JOIN "customers" c ON r."customerid" = c."customerid"
ORDER BY r."number_of_stars" DESC NULLS LAST;
327:
SELECT
    r."number_of_stars",
    c."fullname"
FROM "reviews" r
JOIN "customers" c ON c."customerid" = r."customerid"
ORDER BY r."number_of_stars" DESC NULLS LAST, c."fullname" ASC NULLS FIRST;
328:
SELECT r."customer_reviews", c."fullname"
FROM "reviews" r
JOIN "customers" c ON r."customerid" = c."customerid"
ORDER BY c."fullname" ASC NULLS FIRST;
334:
SELECT
    h."name" AS hotel_name,
    r."customer_reviews" AS review_text,
    r."number_of_stars" AS stars
FROM "reviews" r
JOIN "hotels" h ON h."hotelid" = r."hotelid"
ORDER BY h."name" ASC NULLS FIRST, r."number_of_stars" DESC NULLS LAST;
